name: pcap-capture
title: Capture Traffic (PCAP)
description: Captura de tráfego de rede (tcpdump). Interface, filtro (BPF), output (pcap file), duration (live timeout).

steps.action: Call MCP tool 'pcap' (interface='eth0', filter='tcp port 80' or 'icmp') to capture packets to a file.
steps.expected_output: PcapResult: interface, packets, file (path, e.g., /tmp/xxx.pcap), provenance.

steps.action: Call MCP tool 'pcapLive' (interface='eth0', filter='tcp port 443', duration=30) for live (long-running) capture.

error_handling: If 'error.code=403': report 'Permission denied (root privileges required for raw socket).'
If 'error.code=404': report 'tcpdump binary not found (install: brew install tcpdump or apt install tcpdump).'.
